summary: Important: gstreamer1-plugins-bad-free and gstreamer1-plugins-ugly-free security update
details:
GStreamer is a streaming media framework based on graphs of filters which operate on media data. The gstreamer1-plugins-bad-free package contains a collection of plug-ins for GStreamer.

Security Fix(es):

* gstreamer: gstreamer1-plugins-bad-free: gstreamer: heap out-of-bounds write in adpcmdec IMA/DVI ADPCM decoder (CVE-2026-19387)

* gstreamer: gstreamer1-plugins-ugly-free: gstreamer: integer overflow/underflow in asfdemux bounds checks leading to out-of-bounds read (CVE-2026-19389)

For more details about the security issue(s), including the impact, a CVSS score, acknowledgments, and other related information, refer to the CVE page(s) listed in the References section.
